resolution: Built the unified Color Studio spine (turn 3a of design_handoff_color_studio/) on top of the existing Material Palette (turn 4a) that another session had already built: a Material Palette / Workbench / No-Modes tab switcher on the Color Studio panel in cart/editor/. Workbench adds one current OKLCH color + one palette tray shared across five lenses (Field, Mix, Scene, Ramp, Library), each reading/writing the same spine; No-Modes shows the same color as an orbiting harmony/ramp/scene ring. Added OKLCH<->rgb conversion + hue-distance helpers to runtime/paint/colors.ts (shared color vocabulary), a new cart/editor/data/colorSpine.ts for pure derivations (harmony fits, field nodes, ramp forge, curated library matching), 11 new one-export-per-file React components under cart/editor/stage/, and additive classifier entries in workspace.cls.ts. Wired end to end through AppFrame -> Workspace -> Stage -> MaterialFocusSurface following the existing colorStudio* prop-threading convention. Verified with a full esbuild bundle of cart/editor (all aliases resolved, new symbols confirmed present in the output). Two sessions were working this same working tree concurrently; committed only the files I actually touched, leaving unrelated in-flight files from the other session (commands.ts, persistView.ts, ContextMenu.tsx, DropdownMenu.tsx, memoryDiagnostics.ts, MemoryPopover.tsx, ModelDocumentSurface.tsx, ToolOptions.tsx, ModelContextMenu.tsx) uncommitted for them to land themselves. Remaining/not done: generalized vec3f slot extraction from fillShader.ts (host/shader work, out of scope for this React pass), and the curated library's online-fetch import path (still a stub 'discover online' pill).
